items.title: Is Qualcomm Stock As Cheap As It Looks Now?
items.summary: If you have watched Qualcomm this year, the worry is easy to name. Its sales are shrinking. Over the six months to Monday, November 23, the stock returned -32.9%, counting dividends. The S&P 500 returned -3.2% over the same dates. On Monday alone, Qualcomm rose 10.3.

items.title: Should Softer Guidance Require Action From Qualcomm Stock Investors
items.summary: Qualcomm reported Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings that exceeded EPS expectations, although adjusted revenue was 7% lower year on year and guidance pointed to softer future sales and margin pressure. The cautious outlook, including concerns around handset demand, cost pressures and AI chip export controls, highlighted how Qualcomm’s evolving business mix faces practical execution and profitability challenges.
